name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Attachment (a file attached to a message or a prompt): a 2px ink frame, a fine-framed media square, title in the reading face and description in small mono. States via state: done (rest), uploading (a running line along the bottom edge), processing (the manga Spinner in the media square), error (accent line, a mark-error '!' and accent description), idle (a solid line with a '+' mark). AttachmentTrigger makes the whole card clickable (hover-lift, focus ring); AttachmentAction is a small square ink button with hover-thicken. AttachmentGroup wraps. Sizes default, sm, xs; orientation horizontal or vertical.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/attachment". It wraps your own components/ui/attachment, so Radix and Base UI both work: never pass render or asChild to AttachmentTrigger.

meta.tagline: A file attached to a message, with its progress and errors.
meta.usage:
import { Attachment, AttachmentMedia, AttachmentContent, AttachmentTitle, AttachmentDescription, AttachmentActions, AttachmentAction } from "@/components/ui/manga/attachment"

<Attachment state="uploading">
  <AttachmentMedia>…</AttachmentMedia>
  <AttachmentContent>
    <AttachmentTitle>page-12.png</AttachmentTitle>
    <AttachmentDescription>Uploading 64%</AttachmentDescription>
  </AttachmentContent>
  <AttachmentActions>
    <AttachmentAction aria-label="Remove">×</AttachmentAction>
  </AttachmentActions>
</Attachment>

props.name: state
props.description: The look of the file: running line, spinner, accent error or idle '+'.
